negative_results: Reanalysis is not replication: re-running the same code on the same data is a RERUN that reproduces an analysis, not the phenomenon. refuse_reanalysis_as_replication raises.
A single laboratory's residual stays at the UNEXPLAINED_INSTRUMENT_RESIDUAL ceiling: fewer than two mutually independent confirmations cannot promote it. refuse_promotion_without_replication raises.
A same-lab re-run is not an independent replication: two confirmations sharing an operator, apparatus, or site are not mutually independent, so only one counts. refuse_same_lab_as_independent raises.

A skipped-firewall confirmation does not count: a replication that did not run the ordinary-explanation attacks, did not survive them, or did not exceed its own error budget is not a confirmation. refuse_confirmation_bias raises.

Synthetic implementation replication differs from physical lab replication: is_physical_replication requires a REAL acquisition with a raw artifact, and no such artifact exists here, so every receipt is a SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION.
Failed and contradicting replications are preserved in the hash-chained bundle, never discarded; retracting one of two confirmations drops the status back to the ceiling.
A REPLICATED_ANOMALY is still not new physics and there is no PHRYLL_DETECTED state (refuse_residual_as_new_physics, refuse_phryll_detected).
No physical measurement was performed; measured_here is nothing and PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED.
reopening_test: Reopen a REPLICATED_ANOMALY if any contributing replication is retracted, found non-independent (a shared operator, apparatus, or site), or found to have skipped the ordinary-explanation firewall, dropping the mutually independent confirming count below 2. Reopen a residual toward promotion ONLY via at least 2 mutually independent replications — distinct operator AND apparatus AND site, distinct from the origin and from each other — each following the frozen protocol hash, producing a residual that exceeds its own error budget, and surviving the full firewall. A same-lab re-run or a reanalysis of the same data cannot reopen it, and it is never new physics. A physical replication is reopened only when a built, calibrated apparatus at a distinct site, operated by a distinct operator, produces a captured raw artifact with a clock and environment binding and an uncertainty budget.
